name: Night Drive
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless synthwave: neon grid, striped sun, night road
description: Night Drive plays generated synthwave without end. A driving bass, a plucked arpeggio, lush detuned pads, a big gated snare and now and then a lead line, over minor-key progressions. Sections build and drop (intro, drive, break, build) and the key moves now and then. The screen is a neon grid road running toward a striped sunset, mountains on the horizon, the grid pulsing on the kick. Fourteen presets, each its own sound and colours; four knobs: speed, brightness, arpeggio density and drift.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
